card.name: Trial-arm comparisons after percentages
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as in, vs and the end of a trial or drug name, right after a percentage that compares two treatment groups in adverse-reaction text.

modes.label: Linking word after a percentage
modes.description: The word 'in' or 'vs' follows a percent figure and introduces the comparison arm.
modes.example: Myeloid growth factor support was provided at a rate of 78% in the VcR-CAP arm and 61%<< in>> the R-CHOP arm.

modes.label: End of a trial or drug name
modes.description: The last piece of a study or drug name inside a comparison of adverse-reaction rates.
modes.example: Grade 3 proteinuria occurred in 11% and 6% in SELECT and REF<<LECT>>, respectively.
